items.title: CLTK
items.description: Toolkit for many of the world's classical languages. Support for Sanskrit. Some parts of the Sanskrit library are forked from the Indic NLP Library.

items.title: iNLTK
items.description: iNLTK aims to provide out of the box support for various NLP tasks that an application developer might need for Indic languages.

items.title: Indic NLP Library
items.description: Python Library for various Indian language NLP tasks like tokenization, sentence splitting, normalization, script conversion, transliteration, etc

children.title: Devnagri to Roman transliteration
children.description: using hand-crafted rules and lexicons.

items.title: BNLP
items.description: Bengali language processing toolkit with tokenization, embedding, POS tagging, NER suppport

items.title: Sanskrit Coders Indic Transliteration
items.description: Script conversion and romanization for Indian languages.

items.title: CodeSwitch
items.description: Language identification, POS Tagging, NER, sentiment analysis support for code mixed data including Hindi and Nepali language

items.title: IndIE
items.description: An Open Information Extraction tool (triple extractor) in Hindi. It is conjectured to work for Tamil, Telugu, and Urdu as well.

items.title: Hindi-BenchIE
items.description: A triple evaluation tool for 112 Hindi sentences.

children.title: Sanskrit-Hindi-MT
children.description: The Sanskrit Monolingual Data is available here.

children.title: Lot Of Indic Tweets Corpus
children.description: Large twitter datasets for telugu (7.9 million) and hindi (17.6 million) and fasttext skipgram and cbow word vectors for the same.

children.title: CMU Romanized Hinglish Corpus
children.description: See THIS PAPER for details.

children.title: JNU-BHLTR Bhojpuri Corpus
children.description: Bhojpuri corpus of 45k sentences.

children.title: Kangri_corpus
children.description: Monolingual corpus of Himachali low resource endangered language, Kangri comprising of 1,81,552 sentences. Described in this paper.

children.title: KMI Linguistics Bodo
children.description: Contains the Bodo corpus and the frequency-ordered word and punctuation list.

children.title: FacebookDecadeCorpora
children.description: Contains two language corpora of colloquial Sinhala content extracted from Facebook using the Crowdtangle platform. The larger corpus contains 28,825,820 to 29,549,672 words of text, mostly in Sinhala, English and Tamil and the smaller corpus amounts to 5,402,76 words of only Sinhala text extracted from Corpus-Alpha. Described in this paper.

children.title: [AIBharat IndicCorp]: Text corpora for Indian languages
v2
children.description: contains 20 billion tokens from 22 Indian languages (including Indian English). [paper]

children.title: v1
children.description: contains 8.9 billion tokens from 12 Indian languages (including Indian English). [paper]

children.title: Toxicity-200
children.description: Toxicity Lists for 200 languages including 27 Indian languages.

children.title: AI4Bharat Word Frequency Lists
children.description: Tokens and their frequencies from the AI4Bharat corpus, a large monolingual corpus.

children.title: IIIT-Hyderabad Word Similarity Database
children.description: 7 Indian languages

children.title: Hindi RG-63
children.description: Hindi version of the Rubenstein and Goodenough (RG-65) word similarity dataset

children.title: IITB Cognate Datasets
children.description: Dataset of Cognates and False Friend Pairs for 12 Indian Languages. (Paper)

children.title: FacebookDecadeCorpora
children.description: Contains a list of algorithmically derived stopwords extracted from Corpus-Sinhala-Redux. Described in this paper.

children.title: L3Cube-MahaNER
children.description: The first major gold standard named entity recognition dataset in Marathi consisting of 25,000 sentences in Marathi language. Described in this paper.

children.title: CFILT HiNER
children.description: A large Hindi NER dataset containing 109,146 sentences and 2,220,856 tokens. Described in this paper.

children.title: CCMatrix
children.description: Parallel corpus mined from CommonCrawl, looks noisy (statmt repo).

children.title: FLORES-101
children.description: Human translated evaluation sets for 101 languages released by Facebook. It includes 14 Indic languages. The testsets are n-way parallel.

children.title: FLORES-200
children.description: Human translated evaluation sets for 200 languages released by Facebook. It includes 24 Indic languages. The testsets are n-way parallel.

children.title: FLORES dataset
children.description: English-Sinhala and English-Nepali corpora

children.title: NLLB-Seed
children.description: Small human-translated parallel corpora from Wikipedia articles for very low resource languages. Includes 5 Indian languages: Kashmiri, Manipuri, Maithili, Bhojpuri, Chattisgarhi.

children.title: NLLB-MD
children.description: NLLB Multi Domain is a set of professionally-translated sentences in News, Unscripted informal speech, and Health domains. Cover Bhojpuri amongst Indian languages.

children.title: BPCC Parallel Corpus
children.description: Largest parallel corpus for English and 22 Indian languages (as of Jan 2024). It comprises 230 million sentence pairs between English-Indian languages. A subset of this corpus is the BPCC-Human Corpus containing 2.2 English-Indic pairs for 22 Indic languages.

children.title: BUET English-Bangla Corpus, EMNLP-2020
children.description: 2.7M sentences (has overlaps with OPUS)

children.title: Itihasa Parallel Corpus
children.description: 93k parallel sentences between English and Sanskrit from the Ramanyana and Mahabharata.

children.title: Kathmandu University-English–Nepali Parallel Corpus
children.description: A parallel corpus of size 1.8 million sentence pairs for a low resource language pair Nepali–English. Described in this paper.

children.title: Sanskrit-Hindi-MT
children.description: Machine Translation from Sanskrit to Hindi using Unsupervised and Supervised Learning. Contains Sanskrit-English parallel data and Sanskrit-Hindi parallel(test) data.

children.title: SAP Software Documentation
children.description: test and evaluation set for English-Hindi in the software documentation domain [paper]

children.title: NLPC-UoM English-Tamil Corpus
children.description: 9k sentences, 24k glossary terms

children.title: IIIT-H en-hi-codemixed-corpus
children.description: A gold standard parallel corpus consisting of 6096 English-Hindi code-mixed sentences containing a total of 63,913 tokens and monolingual English. Described in this paper.

children.title: Uka Tarsadia University Corpus
children.description: 65k English-Gujarati sentence pairs. Corpus is described in this paper

children.title: MTEnglish2Odia
children.description: English-Odia (42k pairs)

children.title: IndoWordnet Parallel Corpus
children.description: Parallel corpora mined from IndoWordNet gloss and/or examples for Indian-Indian language corpora (6.3 million segments, 18 languages).

children.title: JNU-BHLTR Bhojpuri Corpus
children.description: English-Bhojpuri corpus of 65k sentences

children.title: Kangri_corpus
children.description: The corpus contains 27,362 Hindi-Kangri Parallel corpora. Described in [this paper] (https://arxiv.org/abs/2103.11596).

children.title: CoPara
children.description: Long-context parallel corpora for 4 Dravidian languages. Contains 2586 passage pairs mined from New India Samachar [paper]

children.title: Dakshina Dataset
children.description: The Dakshina dataset is a collection of text in both Latin and native scripts for 12 South Asian languages. Contains an aggregate of around 300k word pairs and 120k sentence pairs.

children.title: Xlit-Crowd
children.description: Hindi-English Transliteration Corpus created via crowdsourcing.

children.title: NotAI-tech English-Telugu
children.description: Around 38k word pairs

children.title: iNLTK News Headlines classification
children.description: Datasets for multiple Indian languages.

children.title: BBC news articles classification dataset
children.description: 14 class classification

children.title: AI4Bharat IndicNLP News Articles
children.description: Word embeddings for 10 Indian languages.

children.title: XCOPA
children.description: A Multilingual Dataset for Causal Commonsense Reasoning in 11 languages (includes Tamil). Described in this paper.

children.title: KMI Linguistics TRAC - 1
children.description: Contains aggression-annotated dataset (in English and Hindi) for the Shared Task on Aggression Identification during First Workshop on Trolling, Aggression and Cyberbullying (TRAC - 1) at COLING - 2018.

children.title: Bengali Sentiment Analysis - Classification Benchmark, 2020
children.description: 8k sentences

children.title: BHAAV (भाव) Corpus
children.description: A Text Corpus for Emotion Analysis from Hindi Stories

children.title: SentNoB
children.description: sentiment dataset for Bangla from 3 domains on user comments containing 15k examples (Paper) (Dataset)

children.title: UoM-Sinhala Sentiment Analysis
children.description: Sentiment Analysis for Sinhala Language. Consists of a multi-class annotated data set with 15059 sentiment annotated Sinhala news comments extracted from two Sinhala online news papers with four sentiment categories namely POSITIVE, NEGATIVE, NEUTRAL and CONFLICT and a corpus of 9.48 million tokens. Described in this paper.

children.title: Fear Speech in Indian WhatsApp Groups, 2021
Bengali Hate Speech - Classification Benchmark, 2020
children.description: 1.5k sentences

children.title: Roman Urdu Offensive Language Detection, 2020
children.description: 10k tweets, can also used for Hindi, (Paper)

children.title: HateCheckHIn
children.description: An evaluation dataset for Hindi Hate Speech Detection Models having a total of 34 functionalities out of which 28 functionalities are monolingual and the remaining 6 are multilingual. Hindi is used as the base language. Described in this paper.

children.title: Did You Offend Me? Classification of Offensive Tweets in Hinglish Language, 2018
children.description: 3k tweets (Paper)

children.title: A Dataset of Hindi-English Code-Mixed Social Media Text for Hate Speech Detection, 2018
children.description: 4.5k Tweets (Paper)

children.title: TyDi QA datasets
children.description: QA dataset for Bengali and Telugu.

children.title: Facebook Multilingual QA datasets
children.description: Contains dev and test sets for Hindi.

children.title: XQuAD
children.description: testset for Hindi QA from human translation of subset of SQuAD v1.1. Described in this paper

children.title: XQA
children.description: testset for Tamil QA. Described in this paper

children.title: XOR QA
children.description: A large-scale cross-lingual open-retrieval QA dataset (includes Bengali and Telugu) with 40k newly annotated open-retrieval questions that cover seven typologically diverse languages. Described in this paper. More information is available here.

children.title: IITH HiDG
children.description: A Distractor Generation Dataset for Hindi consisting of 1k/1k/5k (train/validation/test) split. Described in this paper

children.title: MMQA dataset
children.description: Hindi QA dataset described in this paper

children.title: HindiRC
children.description: A Dataset for Reading Comprehension in Hindi containing 127 questions and 24 passages. Described in this paper

children.title: A Code-Mixed Medical Task-Oriented Dialog Dataset
children.description: The dataset contains 3005 Telugu–English Code-Mixed dialogs with 29 k utterances covering ten specializations with an average code-mixing index (CMI) of 33.3%. Described in this paper.

children.title: JNU-BHLTR Bhojpuri Corpus
children.description: Bhojpuri corpus of 5000 sentences.

children.title: Vedic Sanskrit Treebank
children.description: 4k Sanskrit dependency treebank [paper]

children.title: XL-Sum
children.description: A Large-Scale Multilingual Abstractive Summarization for 44 Languages with a comprehensive and diverse dataset comprising of 1 million professionally annotated article-summary pairs from BBC. Span 150k examples across 10 Indic languages. Described in this paper.

children.title: WikiLingua
children.description: Cross-lingual summarization dataset created from WikiHow. Contains 9k English-Hindi article-summary pairs. [paper]

children.title: MassiveSum
children.description: A large summarization dataset for containing 13 Indian languages with ~1.9million article-summary pairs. The summaries are mined from article metadata. [paper]

children.title: Sanskrit-Hindi-MT
children.description: The FastText embeddings for Sanskrit is available here and for Hindi here.

children.title: UoM-Sinhala Sentiment Analysis- FastText 300
children.description: The FastText word embedding model for Sinhala language. Described in this paper.

children.title: BERT Multilingual
children.description: BERT model trained on Wikipedias of many languages (including major Indic languages).

children.title: LASER3
children.description: Encoder models suitable for sentence retrieval tasks supporting 200 languages (including 27 Indic languges).

children.title: iNLTK
children.description: ULMFit and TransformerXL pre-trained embeddings for many languages trained on Wikipedia and some News articles.

children.title: BanglaBERT
children.description: Language Model Pretraining and Benchmarks for Low-Resource Language Understanding Evaluation in Bangla. Described in this paper.

children.title: Bangla-BERT-Base
children.description: Bengali BERT model trained on Bengali wikipedia and OSCAR datasets.

items.title: Vāksañcayaḥ Sanskrit Speech Corpus
items.description: 78 hours of speech corpus in Sanskrit prose, with a speaker disjoint splits of train, dev and test. It also contains an additional out of domain test data with speakers having pronunciation influences from L1 (paper).
